items.title: Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Charles Tolliver as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Charles Tolliver was born in Jacksonville, Florida in 1942. He has made his mark in the jazz world as a trumpet player, composer, and co-founder of Strata- East Records Charles was interviewed via Zoom on May 6, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased, at 10 AM in the morning (not a jazz musician’s time usually) but to have Charles Tolliver as a guest today. Thank you for joining me.
